protocol.requestIdentifiers: Send x-correlation-id on every request; the API echoes it so a failed call can be traced without credentials.

problemDetails.note: JSON error envelopes are RFC 9457-compatible problem objects plus the stable error code extension. The contract does not claim application/problem+json transport until the API serves it.

protocol.pagination: Collection operations use opaque cursor and bounded limit parameters. Follow the returned nextCursor; do not parse cursors.

sorting.note: No public sort parameter is currently supported; preserve the contract-defined order.

protocol.idempotency: Mutations marked caller-supplied or durable-replay require idempotency-key. Reuse a key only for the same logical command.
protocol.concurrency: Operations marked with a version precondition require the quoted current version in If-Match and return 412 or 428 when stale or absent.
protocol.retry: Retry only operations marked safe. Unsafe operations are never automatically retried even when they carry a caller request identity.

rateLimits.note: No public quota or 429 retry interval is promised by this contract. Treat 429 as non-automatic and contact support with the correlation ID.

longRunningOperations.note: Only bulk-access execution exposes a durable operation resource. Poll its operation URL; other operations are not documented as asynchronous jobs.

lifecycle.compatibility: Additive schemas and operations require release review; generated clients and rendered reference must be regenerated from the same contract.
lifecycle.versioning: Stable operations remain on /v1. A breaking contract change requires a new major path and a separately supported contract.
lifecycle.breakingChanges: Removing or moving an operation, tightening inputs, changing authority, or changing response shapes requires a new major path.
lifecycle.deprecation: Deprecated operations are marked in OpenAPI and announced with Deprecation and Sunset dates before removal.
lifecycle.sunset: A deprecated operation stays available until its published Sunset date; no unpublished minimum duration is promised.
lifecycle.supportWindow: The published contract version and any explicitly non-sunset major path are supported; preview and unpublished surfaces are excluded.
